page.layout: One printed page, photographed at a steep angle and rotated. Upper block: a column of index entries running diagonally from upper left, with page-number references. Lower block: a second column of entries with a large initial "Q" and a bold heading "Indulgentiarum", continuing to the right. Right edge: a further column partly cut off by the scan edge and largely illegible. No running head, page number or signature is visible.
page.notes: Scan photographed at a steep angle; the upper part of the page is rotated and blurred, and the right side is cut off by the scan edge. Most lines are only partly legible; the entries are marked as illegible where the letters could not be read with certainty. Page number, running head and signature are not legible. The large "Q" and "Indulgentiarum" heading are read from the blurred scan and may be inaccurate. Lines are given in visual order, not the printed reading order, because the rotation makes column breaks unreliable.
